COLUMBUS, Miss., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BankFirst Capital Corporation (OTCQX: BFCC) (the "Company") announced today that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $1.15 per share payable December 10, 2026, to shareholders of record as of December 1, 2026. 

Moak Griffin, President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company and BankFirst Financial Services, the Company's wholly-owned subsidiary bank, stated, "We are pleased to announce our 2026 dividend of $1.15 per share of common stock." 

ABOUT BANKFIRST CAPITAL CORPORATION
BankFirst Capital Corporation (OTCQX: BFCC) is a registered bank holding company headquartered in Columbus, Mississippi with approximately $3.43 billion in total assets as of September 30, 2026. BankFirst Financial Services, the Company's wholly-owned banking subsidiary, was founded in 1888 and is locally owned, controlled, and operated. The Bank is headquartered in Macon, Mississippi, and operates additional branch offices in Bay Springs, Coldwater, Columbus, Flowood, Heidelberg, Hattiesburg, Hernando, Independence, Jackson, Laurel, Louin, Madison, Newton, Oxford, Petal, Senatobia, Southaven, Starkville, Taylorsville, Tupelo, Water Valley, and West Point, Mississippi; and Addison, Aliceville, Arley, Carrollton, Curry, Double Springs, Fayette, Gordo, Haleyville, Northport, and Tuscaloosa, Alabama. The Bank also operates four loan production offices in Biloxi and Brookhaven, Mississippi, and in Birmingham and Huntsville, Alabama. BankFirst offers a wide variety of services for businesses and consumers. The Bank also offers internet banking, no-fee ATM access, checking, CD, and money market accounts, merchant services, mortgage loans, remote deposit capture, and more. For more information, visit www.BankFirstfs.com.

Company achieves $1.22 million in quarterly revenue and a 55% net profit margin as additional investment offerings are underway on its real-world asset marketplace.

Las Vegas, Nevada, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Primior Holdings Inc. (OTCMKT: PTKN) today announced its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, highlighted by significant year-over-year profitability growth, improved operating margins, and continued expansion of the GAIA Marketplace ecosystem.

The Company more than doubled its quarterly net income compared to the same period last year, reflecting improved operational efficiency while continuing to advance its strategy of integrating real estate, private markets, and asset tokenization through a unified digital investment platform.

Q3 2026 Financial Highlights (Unaudited)

  • Gross margin: 74.0%, compared to 69.3% in Q3 2025
  • Operating income: $674,141, +89.3% YoY
  • Net income: $674,141, +101.6% YoY
  • Net profit margin: 55.0%, compared to 30.4% in Q3 2025
  • Operating expenses: -42.5% YoY
  • Earnings per share (basic and diluted): $0.00015894 +83.1% YoY

GAIA Marketplace Continues to Expand

Primior continues to advance the commercialization of GAIA, its proprietary real-world asset (RWA) tokenization marketplace, with additional investment offerings and new issuer listings currently underway.

With new offerings progressing through the onboarding and listing process, GAIA is positioned to broaden its investment selection beyond its existing offerings and expand its potential revenue opportunities through marketplace fees, tokenization services, and other platform-related activities.

The Company recognized sizable marketplace fee revenue during the third quarter, reflecting continued commercialization of its technology infrastructure.

Building a Scalable Private Markets Ecosystem

While Primior's established real estate operations continue to generate revenue and profitability, the Company remains focused on expanding GAIA as a scalable platform for capital formation and alternative investments.

Management believes that expanding the number and diversity of investment offerings on GAIA is an important component of its long-term growth strategy, creating opportunities to attract additional investors and issuers while diversifying the Company's potential revenue streams.

Through the integration of traditional asset management, private market investments, and blockchain-enabled infrastructure, Primior seeks to establish GAIA as a comprehensive marketplace for accessing and participating in the evolving real-world asset economy.

About Primior Holdings Inc.

Primior Holdings Inc. (OTCMKT: PTKN) advances next-generation financial solutions through GAIA, its proprietary real-world asset tokenization marketplace. The Company combines real estate development, asset management, capital markets expertise, and digital infrastructure to facilitate access to alternative investment opportunities.

Primior is focused on developing an integrated financial ecosystem that connects traditional private markets with emerging blockchain-enabled investment infrastructure.

Hamilton, Bermuda, November 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Borr Drilling Limited (NYSE: BORR) (OSE: BORR) ("Borr", "Borr Drilling" or the "Company") announces unaudited results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.

Highlights

  • Third Quarter total operating revenues of $263.1 million, an increase of $30.8 million or 13% compared to the second quarter of 2026.
  • Third Quarter net loss of $38.7 million, a decrease in net loss of $202.7 million compared to the second quarter of 2026, primarily due to the $176.3 million debt extinguishment charge recognized in the prior quarter in connection with the refinancing of the Company's senior secured notes due 2028 and 2030 and convertible bonds due 2028.
  • Third Quarter Adjusted EBITDA of $78.9 million, an increase of $35.1 million or 80% compared to the second quarter of 2026.
  • Year-to-date 2026, the Company has been awarded 30 contract commitments, representing approximately 6,300 days and $810 million of Dayrate Equivalent Backlog.

Subsequent events
On October 24, 2026, an incident occurred with the Prospector 5 rig offshore Gabon, where the rig sank and subsequently has been declared a total loss. The rig's insured value is $200 million, with the insurance payment due date set for November 24, 2026. Additionally, we carry comprehensive third-party liability insurance, which includes coverage related to wreck removal and pollution. We continue to assess the financial impact of the Prospector 5 incident on the Company.

Chief Executive Officer Bruno Morand commented:
"Following the incident involving the Prospector 5 offshore Gabon, which the Company first announced on October 25, 2026, we continue to work closely with our customer BW Energy, the relevant authorities and other stakeholders in the ongoing response efforts. Our thoughts remain with our colleagues and their families affected by this incident, and their wellbeing continues to be our highest priority.

Moving to our performance for the third quarter of 2026, our operations resulted in technical utilization of 98.0% and economic utilization of 97.3%. Revenues for the period were $263.1 million, with an average of 22.9 operating rigs. Third-quarter Adjusted EBITDA was $78.9 million, a quarter-on-quarter increase of $35.1 million consistent with our expectations. This improvement reflects higher revenues, following an elevated number of rig transitions during the second quarter, and the non-recurrence of a credit loss provision recorded in the prior period. We currently anticipate Q4 Adjusted EBITDA performance to be broadly in line with Q3, despite the Prospector 5 impact.

Turning to the market, since our last quarterly report, we have secured nine contract commitments in key geographies outside the Middle East. These include an award to deploy the previously idle rig Hild offshore Nigeria, strengthening our presence in this growing region. The nine commitments added approximately $269 million in backlog and represent more than 1,950 days of additional firm work, bringing our contract coverage for 2026 and 2027 to 79% and 52%, respectively.

We are also seeing encouraging signs for shallow-water activity, with an increasing number of opportunities in Southeast Asia and West Africa in particular. Recent market developments reflect the continued recovery in marketed utilization for modern jack-ups, which now stands at approximately 93%, compared to around 90% nine months ago, despite persistent disruptions in the Middle East.

Based on current forward coverage, we anticipate full-year 2027 Adjusted EBITDA to be broadly in line with full-year 2026, with expectations for Q1 2027 to be sequentially lower and a strong ramp-up in Q4. The Company's strong liquidity position provides the financial flexibility to capitalize on opportunities as the market recovers. For now, our near-term priority remains maximizing fleet utilization, while maintaining a disciplined approach to longer-term commitments to create sustainable shareholder value."

NEW YORK, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK) ("Newmark" or "the Company"), a leading commercial real estate advisor and service provider to large institutional investors, global corporations and other owners and occupiers, announces it has been appointed as the exclusive retail leasing agent for Mizner Park, an approximately 840,000-square-foot mixed-use destination in downtown Boca Raton, Florida. The appointment follows the property's recent acquisition by a joint venture comprising CP Group, The Georgetown Company and ACRE, alongside investment partner StepStone.

Managing Director Mitch Heifetz will lead leasing and marketing efforts for the property's 276,000-square-foot retail component on behalf of the new ownership group. Executive Vice Chairman Ariel Schuster will collaborate with Heifetz on the assignment.

"Mizner Park has long been a defining destination in downtown Boca Raton and Palm Beach County as a whole, with an established identity and strong connection to the surrounding community," said Heifetz. "The planned repositioning presents an opportunity to further elevate its retail and dining mix while reinforcing its appeal as a premier shopping and lifestyle destination."

Ownership plans to implement a comprehensive repositioning of Mizner Park, focused on enhancing its retail offerings, streetscape and overall visitor experience. Led by The Georgetown Company in collaboration with CP Group and ACRE, planned improvements include upgrades to building facades, landscaping, wayfinding and infrastructure. The strategy will also focus on refining the property's retail merchandising mix and strengthening its connection to the surrounding community, while recapturing its status as a leading mixed-use lifestyle shopping center in the country.

Georgetown brings decades of experience developing, repositioning and managing major mixed-use properties across the country, including Easton Town Center in Columbus, Ohio, Halcyon in Alpharetta, Georgia, 787 Eleventh Avenue in New York City and Campus 244, an adaptive-reuse redevelopment in Atlanta, among many others.

"Mizner Park has been an important part of Boca Raton for more than three decades, and we see tremendous opportunity to help grow its future," said Jonathan Schmerin, Managing Principal of The Georgetown Company. "Alongside our partners, we're excited to work with the City and community to strengthen the tenant mix, bring new energy to the property and reinforce its position as one of America's signature shopping, dining and entertainment destinations. We look forward to sharing more about our long-term vision as plans take shape."

Originally developed by CP Group between 1991 and 1999, Mizner Park is an open-air destination featuring retail, dining, entertainment, office space and 272 residential apartments. Located along Plaza Real in downtown Boca Raton, the property features landscaped promenades and pedestrian-friendly gathering spaces, with convenient access to surrounding residential neighborhoods and the downtown business district.

About Newmark
Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK), together with its subsidiaries ("Newmark"), is a world leading commercial real estate advisor and service provider to large institutional investors and other owners, global corporations and other occupiers, and lenders. Built with purpose and driven by excellence, Newmark's comprehensive platform is uniquely tailored to provide superior outcomes to clients. For the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, Newmark generated revenues of over $3.7 billion. As of September 30, 2026, Newmark and its business partners together operated from approximately 200 offices with 10,500 professionals across four continents. Learn more at nmrk.com or follow @newmark.

MIDLAND, Pa., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Big Digital Energy, Inc. (“We,” “Big Digital” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: “BGDE”), a developer and operator of next-generation digital infrastructure, today announced that William Regan will step down as Chief Financial Officer, effective January 4, 2027. Regan will continue serving as Chief Financial Officer until that date to support an orderly handover of the Company's financial reporting and finance operations.

Big Digital management has identified a successor with deep industry expertise and considerable overlap with its development goals. The Company is finalizing the details and expects to announce their appointment shortly. Big Digital does not anticipate any disruption to its financial reporting or operations as a result of the transition.

“On behalf of the Board of Directors and management team, I would like to thank Bill for his leadership and contributions to Big Digital during an important period in the Company's development,” said Josh Kilgore, Executive Chairman of Big Digital. “Bill has played a key role in strengthening our finance organization and supporting our capital markets initiatives. We appreciate his commitment to ensuring a seamless transition and wish him continued success.”

About Big Digital Energy, Inc.

Big Digital Energy, Inc. (Nasdaq: “BGDE”) is a U.S.-based technology company that designs, builds, and operates next-generation digital infrastructure platforms. The Company provides services spanning artificial intelligence (“AI”), high-performance computing (“HPC”), digital assets (including Bitcoin mining), and other intensive compute applications. The Company delivers both self-mining operations and colocation/hosting for enterprise customers, with a vertically integrated infrastructure model built for scalability and efficiency. A core part of the Company’s strategy is identifying and advancing sites positioned to support high-performance compute with the infrastructure required for long-term deployment. With approximately 169 megawatts of energized capacity and additional capacity under development, the Company is positioning itself as a competitive provider of digital infrastructure solutions to support the demand for AI data centers.

ELKHART, Ind.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--

Patrick Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: PATK) (“Patrick”) and LCI Industries (NYSE: LCII) (“LCI” or “Lippert”) today announced that their shareholders and stockholders, respectively, have approved the proposals necessary to complete the companies’ previously announced all-stock merger.

“Today marks a significant milestone toward bringing Patrick and Lippert together, and we are grateful for the tremendous support from each company’s shareholders,” said Andy Nemeth, Chief Executive Officer of Patrick. “Our two companies share a deep commitment to our team members, customers and stakeholders, and we believe that together we can deliver more cost-effective, innovative solutions across the Outdoor Enthusiast, Housing and Transportation markets.”

“We appreciate the overwhelming support shown at both meetings today, and we are deeply grateful to the team members who work hard every day in service of our customers,” said Johnny Sirpilla, Interim Chief Executive Officer of Lippert. “For decades, Lippert has earned the trust of customers through innovation, reliability and a culture of service, the same values that have contributed to Patrick’s own growth. We are confident that merging the two companies will extend each company’s legacy in a meaningful way, benefiting team members, shareholders, and the community that we are both proud to call home.”

At the special meeting of Patrick shareholders held today, at least 97% of the votes cast, representing approximately 93% of all outstanding shares, were voted in favor of the four proposals related to the merger. At the special meeting of LCI stockholders held today, approximately 98% of the votes cast, representing approximately 82% of all outstanding shares, were voted in favor of the necessary proposal related to the merger.

The voting results for each special meeting will be reported in Current Reports on Form 8-K to be filed by Patrick and LCI, respectively, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”). The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027 and remains subject to the receipt of required regulatory approvals and the satisfaction or waiver of other customary closing conditions.

Additional information about the transaction is available at patrickandlipperttogether.com.

About Patrick Industries, Inc.

Patrick (NASDAQ: PATK) is a leading component solutions provider serving original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket customers in the RV, Marine, Powersports and Housing markets. Since 1959, Patrick has empowered manufacturers and outdoor enthusiasts to achieve next-level recreation experiences. Our customer-focused approach brings together design, manufacturing, distribution, and transportation in a full solutions model that defines us as a trusted partner. Patrick is home to more than 85 leading brands, all united by a commitment to quality, customer service, and innovation. Headquartered in Elkhart, IN, Patrick employs approximately 10,000 skilled team members throughout the United States. For more information on Patrick, our brands, and products, please visit www.patrickind.com.

About LCI Industries

LCI Industries (NYSE: LCII), through its Lippert subsidiary, is a global leader in supplying engineered components to the outdoor recreation and transportation markets. We believe our innovative culture, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and dedication to enhancing the customer experience have established Lippert as a reliable partner for both OEM and aftermarket customers. For more information, visit www.lippert.com.

First quarter of positive Adjusted EBITDA(1) in several fiscal years, continued cost reductions, and re-affirming revenue guidance of approximately $2.0 million in Q4 2026

Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 18, 2026) - Clear Blue Technologies International Inc. (TSXV: CBLU) (FSE: 0YA0) ("Clear Blue"), the Smart Off-Grid™ Company, announces its unaudited financial results for the third fiscal quarter of 2026 ended September 30, 2026 ("Q3 2026"). A complete set of Financial Statements and Management's Discussion & Analysis ("MD&A") has been filed at www.sedarplus.ca. All dollar amounts are denominated in Canadian dollars.

"The second half of 2026 is beginning to yield the results of our new partnerships and products," said Miriam Tuerk, Co-Founder & CEO of Clear Blue. "In the quarter, the company ramped up its production to meet the increase in sales led by the Eutelsat Konnect Wifi orders. Together with our streamlined organization enabled by AI, cost reductions started to drop to the bottom line and allowed us to deliver a more efficient Q3 with positive Adjusted EBITDA. Our focus in 2027 is to continue leveraging our existing strategic partners and execute on new ones that can give us significant scale to achieve our revenue growth goals."

For the three months ended September 30, 2026 ("Q3 2026"):

  • New bookings were $1,435,566 compared to $745,175 in the corresponding period of 2025, an increase of 93%.
  • Revenue was $1,054,468, an 11% increase from $953,972 in the corresponding previous period.
  • Recurring revenue was $139,005, a 15% decrease from $164,032 in the corresponding previous period.
  • Gross profit increased to $401,681 compared to $352,574 in the comparable period, a 14% increase. The gross margin percentage reflects a sales mix where the current and comparable periods had a higher proportion of hardware deliveries.
  • Non-IFRS Adjusted EBITDA for the period was $214,825 as compared to ($331,032) for the previous period. This was the first positive Adjusted EBITDA quarter in several fiscal years and reflects higher gross profit along with a 24% reduction in operating expenses.
  • Net loss for the period was $144,912 compared to a net loss of $789,438 in the corresponding previous period, an improvement of 82%.
  • Working capital as at September 30, 2026, was $381,043 compared to $222,940 as at December 31, 2025.

Subsequent to the fiscal third quarter:

  • Mr. Nick Blitterswyk joined Clear Blue's Board of Directors as an independent director. Mr. Blitterswyk is the founder and former Chief Executive Officer of UGE International, a formerly TSX Venture Exchange-listed solar energy and battery storage company that was acquired by a US private equity firm in 2024. He has been a longtime advisor to the Company's management, and his public company, capital markets and operating experience will support the Company as it enters its next phase of growth.

Management Commentary & Outlook

In fiscal 2025, the Company launched its "Clear Blue 2.0" business strategy. This strategy is centered around product, customer partnerships, scaling sales volumes, and generating positive Adjusted EBITDA. In its Q2 2026 earnings release, the Company provided guidance of $5 million in revenue for 2026. The Company is pleased to re-affirm its revenue guidance for 2026, resulting in an expected quarterly revenue of approximately $2 million for Q4 2026.

Furthermore, Q3 2026 saw positive Adjusted EBITDA for the first time in several fiscal years, showcasing the Company's continued efforts to increase margins and reduce costs. Q4 2026 is expected to continue the improvements in Adjusted EBITDA due to the higher expected revenue and gross margins in line with historical levels.

Going into fiscal 2027, management's goal is to continue this trajectory by delivering potential year-over-year revenue growth and more consistent, positive Adjusted EBITDA in subsequent quarters. This mandate is supported by the Company's customer demand for its new Pico, Pico+, and Senti products, along with new product launches planned for early 2027.

The Company's commercial and strategic relationship with Eutelsat continued to advance. On September 28, 2026, the Company announced that it had received purchase orders from Eutelsat for 1,000 Pico-Plus Smart Off-Grid power systems to support Eutelsat's continued Konnect Wi-Fi rollout for several countries in Africa. The units are expected to be delivered in Q4 2026, and these orders bring the number of units ordered by Eutelsat in 2026 to approximately 1,500. The orders build on the Letter of Intent signed with Eutelsat on December 17, 2025, for a three-year supply agreement targeting approximately 15,000 Pico-Plus systems, contingent on commercial demand.

Eutelsat is an example of the Company's goal to build long-term commercial relationships that can leverage its standardized products and technologies to provide scale. Clear Blue believes that this will support the Company's long-term growth goals and is in the process of developing other similar initiatives, particularly with its Pico product lines.

For the remainder of the year, Clear Blue is focused on closing the year by hitting its Q4 guidance, positioning itself to close on larger customer orders and converting its pipeline to ensure 2027 is another year of revenue growth.

Conference Call Notice

Clear Blue Technologies International Inc. will host a conference call tomorrow on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 11:00 AM Eastern Time to discuss the quarterly results, outlook, and business developments.

All interested parties are invited to participate in the call. To register for the conference call, please use the following link: https://www.clearbluetechnologies.com/events/cblu-2026-q3-earnings-call

Clear Blue Technologies provides Smart Off-Grid™ power solutions and services for mission-critical infrastructure such as telecommunications, Internet of Things (IoT), and street lighting. The Company's technology enables cost savings, predictive maintenance, and reliable power in remote or challenging environments.

TEL AVIV, Israel, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Innoviz Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ: INVZ) (the "Company", "we", or "Innoviz"), a leading supplier of high-performance, automotive-grade LiDAR sensor platforms for the automotive, security, defense, and industrial markets, today announced that it will effect a reverse share split of its ordinary shares, no par value (the "Ordinary Shares"), at a ratio of 1-for-20 (the "Reverse Share Split"), together with a proportionate reduction of its authorized share capital from 500,000,000 to 25,000,000 Ordinary Shares.

The Reverse Share Split is expected to become effective at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on Friday, December 4, 2026 (the "Effective Time"), and the Ordinary Shares are expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on The Nasdaq Stock Market ("Nasdaq") at market open on Monday, December 7, 2026. The Ordinary Shares will continue to trade under the symbol "INVZ." The new CUSIP number for the Ordinary Shares following the Reverse Share Split will be M5R635 124 (ISIN IL0012498957).

The Company's shareholders approved the Reverse Share Split at the annual general meeting held on September 16, 2026, authorizing a ratio of between 1-for-5 and 1-for-20 to be determined by the Company's board of directors. The Reverse Share Split is intended to increase the per share trading price of the Ordinary Shares so that the Company can regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on Nasdaq. There can be no assurance that the Reverse Share Split will have that effect.

Effect on Outstanding Shares

At the Effective Time, every twenty (20) Ordinary Shares issued and outstanding will automatically be combined into one (1) Ordinary Share. The number of outstanding Ordinary Shares will be reduced from approximately 299,546,196 (as of November 17, 2026) to approximately 14,977,309. The Reverse Share Split will affect all shareholders uniformly and will not change any shareholder's percentage ownership interest, except for the treatment of fractional shares described below.

Fractional Shares

No fractional Ordinary Shares will be issued in connection with the Reverse Share Split. Shareholders who would otherwise be entitled to a fractional share will instead receive a cash payment, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes, equal to such fraction multiplied by the closing price of the Ordinary Shares on Nasdaq on December 4, 2026, the trading day immediately preceding the Effective Time (as adjusted to give effect to the Reverse Share Split). Shareholders holding fewer than twenty (20) Ordinary Shares immediately before the Effective Time will receive only cash and will no longer hold Ordinary Shares.

Shareholder Action

Equiniti Trust Company, LLC, the Company's transfer agent, will act as exchange agent. Shareholders holding Ordinary Shares in book-entry form with the transfer agent do not need to take any action; their holdings will be adjusted automatically and any cash payment will be sent to them. Shareholders holding Ordinary Shares through a broker, bank or other nominee do not need to take any action; their accounts will be adjusted, and any cash payment credited, under the nominee's procedures, which may differ from those described above.

Equity Awards and Warrants

Proportionate adjustments will be made to the number of Ordinary Shares issuable under the Company's equity incentive plans and outstanding equity awards, and to the number of Ordinary Shares issuable upon exercise of, and the exercise price of, the Company's outstanding warrants, in each case in accordance with their terms.

Tax Considerations

For a summary of certain U.S. federal income tax and Israeli tax considerations of the Reverse Share Split, including the receipt of cash in lieu of fractional shares, see Exhibit 99.2 to the Company's Report on Form 6-K furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 18, 2026, together with the Company's proxy statement for the annual general meeting held on September 16, 2026. Shareholders are urged to consult their tax advisors with respect to the particular tax consequences of the Reverse Share Split.

About Innoviz
Innoviz is a leading provider of LiDAR technology, serving as a Tier-1 supplier to the world's leading automotive manufacturers while extending its existing sensing solutions into defense, homeland security, industrial, and smart infrastructure markets.

Innoviz's LiDAR sensors and complementary software suite are designed to deliver exceptional range, resolution, and reliability, providing accurate 3D sensing even in harsh weather conditions. Built to meet the automotive industry's strict standards for performance and safety, Innoviz's sensors are increasingly supplied for applications that demand precise, real-time spatial awareness and continuous object localization.

Operating across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, Innoviz designs solutions for automotive OEMs, system integrators, municipalities, commercial enterprises, government organizations, and other customers worldwide. Under the Perciz brand, Innoviz offers its existing automotive-grade LiDAR sensors for defense, counter-UAS, perimeter intrusion detection, and homeland security applications. BIRMINGHAM, Ala., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- First US Bancshares, Inc. (Nasdaq: FUSB) (the "Company"), a Delaware corporation based in Birmingham, Alabama, announced today that its Board of Directors has extended the Company's existing share repurchase program. The Company has repurchased 2,122,972 shares of its common stock to date under the repurchase program, and 1,119,813 shares remain available for repurchase. The Board of Directors has authorized the Company to extend the expiration of the repurchase program from December 31, 2026, to December 31, 2027. The share repurchase program was originally approved by the Company's Board of Directors on January 19, 2006. 

Share repurchases under the repurchase program may be made through open market transactions, through privately negotiated transactions or otherwise at times and in such amounts as management deems appropriate, subject to applicable regulatory requirements. The timing, manner, price and amount of any repurchases will depend on a variety of factors, including the market price of the Company's common stock, trading volume, general market conditions, the Company's capital position and liquidity, and alternative uses of capital. Open market purchases may be executed through a pre-arranged repurchase plan that operates in accordance with the guidelines specified under Rule 10b5-1 and Rule 10b-18 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. The repurchase program does not obligate the Company to acquire any particular number of shares and may be suspended, modified, or discontinued without any prior notice at any time at the Company's discretion.

About First US Bancshares, Inc.

First US Bancshares, Inc. is a bank holding company that operates banking offices in Alabama, Tennessee and Virginia through First US Bank (the "Bank"). The Company files periodic reports with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). Copies of its filings may be obtained through the SEC's website at www.sec.gov or at www.firstusbank.com. More information about the Company and the Bank may be obtained at www.firstusbank.com. The Company's stock is traded on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol "FUSB."
